content: You will never behold the glory of the rainbow if you are constantly looking down at your boots.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
explanation: When trudging through rain, human nature fixates on avoiding puddles, keeping boots dry, and staring at the mud. But high overhead, the storm clouds are parting and the golden sun is refracting an immense emerald and violet arc across the sky. Lift your gaze.
practicalInsight: Lift your head up as you walk outside today. Look at the sky, the trees, and the light, not just the concrete.
reflectionPrompt: Are you so obsessed with avoiding minor daily puddles that you have completely stopped looking up at the sky?
